output.reason: The cited text [ev-f91dbd14d0cc] combines four separate behaviour changes into one change: forceful expiration, AL2023 NodeConfig precedence in UserData, the karpenter.sh/unregistered:NoExecute taint (which Custom amiFamily users must add themselves), and waiting for instances to fully terminate before nodes are removed. Each of these has a different subject, applicability and consequence, so one typed assertion cannot cover them all. The expiration bullet on its own is concrete: nodes start draining as soon as they expire, without waiting for replacement capacity.
